preview_heading: Jamaica Kingsmen vs Guyana Amazon Warriors – CPL 2026 Qualifier 2
preview: Jamaica Kingsmen faced Guyana Amazon Warriors in CPL 2026 Qualifier 2 at Kensington Oval, Barbados, on September 18. Jamaica Kingsmen won by 5 wickets to secure the remaining place in the CPL 2026 final against Antigua & Barbuda Falcons.
preview_detail: Jamaica Kingsmen advanced to Qualifier 2 after defeating Barbados Tridents in the Eliminator, while Guyana Amazon Warriors entered the match following their Qualifier 1 defeat against Antigua & Barbuda Falcons. Guyana Amazon Warriors scored 206/4 in 20 overs. Jamaica Kingsmen reached 207/5 in 19.4 overs to win by 5 wickets and advance to the final.
